resources.string: Browse cached comments
Cached comments

Only comments already saved by TikTok for the current account are shown. Reload reads local storage; it does not download missing comments. Text, author names and cached replies are available; images and profiles are not fetched. Cached translations can be switched per comment. Enable the separate online-translation option to explicitly translate a selected comment when connected; complete results are saved for offline reuse. Missing-comment fetching is not connected.

Online translation for cached comments

Off by default. Prepares TikTok’s translation channel independently; then the cached-comment viewer can submit one explicitly selected comment, display original/translation/bilingual and save complete results privately for later offline viewing. The host channel chooses its target language. No batch/background comment submission or local model is added; local-data-only prevents online requests. Initial preparation may take time.
